nodes.label: Nomenclature deadends catalog D1–D17
nodes.rationale: Benchmark verdict: 'механики у нас есть почти все, а рабочего места — нет' — the section is built as separate screens around one entity while etalons build one registry + one card. Headline deadends: D1 catalog silently cut to 20 items (first DRF page, no pager rendered); D2 import physically lacks category and ТН ВЭД columns while publication requires both → a 3000-row price list yields 3000 unpublishable drafts with a 'Создано: 3000' report; D4 AI writes specifications invisibly (only write path is AI, only read path is the storefront); D5 paid enrich's hs_code is dropped by the client so the seller pays twice for one job; D7 read-only categories page whose caption promises management; D10 archived merge-duplicates vanish from every tab irreversibly; D12 the seller's 'catalog' shows the whole platform's goods without an owner column.

nodes.label: Single product registry with status tabs (Akeneo/Shopify)
nodes.rationale: Akeneo PIM / Shopify Products: ONE registry where status is a tab/filter, with server search, server pagination, sorting and bulk actions — vs our TWO divergent registries (queue without search/pager, catalog without pagination). Target: 'Мои товары' with tabs Кандидаты/Черновики/Опубликовано/Архив (DRAFT split by presence of source_deal/demand_count), duplicate/coverage panels collapsed into banners above the table, ResponsiveDataTable. Menu goes from 6 items to 3 — no more three 'Номенклатуры' meanings and two 'Каталог' entries for a company that both buys and sells.

nodes.label: Product card as full page with sections and in-card completeness (Akeneo/Amazon)
nodes.rationale: Akeneo / Amazon Seller Central: a full-screen page with left-hand sections and the completeness indicator INSIDE the card (each missing item an anchor to its section) — vs our 20-field sheet drawer with no completeness, no specifications field, no media until after save, and no owner actions on ProductDetail. Sections: Основное, Классификация (domain-filtered category combobox, equipment-group tree, ТН ВЭД), Характеристики (manual key/value editor — closes D4), Медиа from step one, Коммерция, Действия. Action buttons by useHasCompanyPermission('catalog.manage'|'catalog.publish'), hidden not disabled (ADR-0005).

nodes.label: AI per-field suggestions panel instead of silent patch
nodes.rationale: Akeneo AI suggestions / Shopify Magic / Amazon Generate listing: a per-field diff panel — Было / Предложение / accept-checkbox — applying only what was checked. Replaces the silent patch where AI merged specifications into the draft with no form field to see or remove them (D4), and makes paid enrich honest: the already-computed hs_code/hs_candidates stop being discarded by the client (D5), uom and category become a CHOICE from the reference lists passed into the prompt, not invented ids (Rule 1). Closes D4, D5, D6 at once.

nodes.label: Import 2.0: AI column mapping + saved supplier profiles
nodes.rationale: Shopify CSV mapping / Akeneo import profiles / Coupa-Ariba CIF: the user maps THEIR price-list columns to card fields (AI proposes, human corrects via dropdowns), the mapping is saved as a supplier profile, re-upload updates. Replaces 'download our template and hit its rigid header aliases'. Three steps: file (xlsx/csv/pdf/photo — pdf/photo reuse the existing заявка extractor), mapping, dry-run whose report adds 'будет неопубликуемо: N (нет категории / нет ТН ВЭД)' + a batch-AI-enrich button. Also: one template instead of two, extra columns (category, ТН ВЭД, domain, equipment groups, photo URL).

nodes.label: Wave plan R1–R7 for the nomenclature redesign
nodes.rationale: R1 truth in lists → R5 import 2.0 → R4 AI suggestions → R2 single registry → R3 card-as-page → R6 reference books → R7 contract hygiene. Order rationale: the owner asked to ease FILLING — R1 makes lists truthful (without it no filling is visible), R5/R4 hit the cost of filling directly, screen recomposition (R2/R3) is about comfort. DoD per wave (PRODUCT RULE 4): eyes-on scenario on real data — '500-row price list → uploaded → batch-AI-enriched → 500 cards published → next заявка auto-matched from the catalog', with screenshots to the owner.
